00107ab52941.name: The Maw-claws of Thyrax
00107ab52941.plain: The bearer's Attacks characteristic is increased by 1, and you can re-roll the wound roll whenever it makes a melee attack. Also, each time the bearer destroys an enemy unit with a melee attack, its Attacks characteristic goes up by 1 more for the rest of the battle, up to a maximum of +3 from this effect.

00cf5d311d0e.name: Voracious Ammunition
00cf5d311d0e.plain: After this model finishes making its attacks each time it shoots, choose one unit that at least one of those attacks hit, then roll one D6: on a 2+, that unit takes D3 mortal wounds.

01d1b950bfc9.name: Insidious Threat
01d1b950bfc9.plain: In your Command phase, pick one of your JORMUNGANDR units within Synaptic Link range of this WARLORD to ignore cover with its attacks. Until your next Command phase starts, targets of its models' attacks get no benefit from cover against them.

046694e37b14.name: Rarefied Enhancements
046694e37b14.plain: Use before the battle, while mustering your army, if your WARLORD has the HIVE TENDRIL keyword. Pick one HIVE TENDRIL CHARACTER model from your army and give it one Relic (one it is allowed to have). Every Relic in your army must be unique, and this Stratagem can't give a model two Relics. You can use this Stratagem only once, or twice in a Strike Force battle, or three times in an Onslaught battle.

0694400c78a6.name: Chameleonic Skin
0694400c78a6.plain: Subtract 1 from the hit roll of every attack made against this model. While this model is receiving the benefits of cover, it can't be chosen as the target of a ranged attack by an attacker more than 12" away. This model has a 5+ invulnerable save.

07700f91d989.name: Hyper-adaptation (Gorgon)
07700f91d989.plain: You may replace this hive fleet's Adaptive rule with one of the Feed or Lurk Biomorphologies.

waive.61: page reference ("page 61") to where the biomorphologies are printed; not part of the rule

07f9803cd9a3.name: Benefits
07f9803cd9a3.plain:
Your units gain the CRUSHER STAMPEDE keyword and one of two abilities, and you unlock the Crusher Stampede Warlord Traits, Stratagems and psychic powers.
• Every unit in your army gains the CRUSHER STAMPEDE keyword.
• Your units that lack the MONSTER keyword gain Shielded by the Hive Mind.
• Your MONSTER units gain the Hulking Behemoths ability.
• You can use the Crusher Stampede Warlord Traits and Stratagems.
• Your CRUSHER STAMPEDE PSYKERS can take their psychic powers from the Mass Convergence discipline.

waive.99: page reference ("pg 99") to where the Crusher Stampede Warlord Traits are printed; not part of the rule
waive.100: page reference ("pg 100") to where the Crusher Stampede Stratagems are printed; not part of the rule
waive.101: page reference ("pg 101") to where the Mass Convergence discipline is printed; not part of the rule

09ba15b53eb8.name: Floating Death (Spore Mine)
09ba15b53eb8.plain: Whenever a model in this unit finishes a move within 3" of any enemy units, or when an enemy unit finishes a move during which one or more of its models came within 3" of a model in this unit, that model of yours can explode. An exploding model is destroyed; pick one of those enemy units and roll a D6: on a 2-4, the picked unit takes 1 mortal wound; on a 5+, it takes D3 mortal wounds.

09e2a45d52d0.name: Unbreakable Chitin
09e2a45d52d0.plain: Use in any phase, when one of your CRUSHER STAMPEDE units is chosen as the target of an attack. For the rest of the phase, attacks against that unit always fail to wound on an unmodified wound roll of 1-3, no matter what abilities the attacking model or its weapon has. Cost: 2CP if that unit has 5 or more models, or has any models with a Wounds characteristic of 10 or more; otherwise 1CP.

0a47a1695196.name: The Horror
0a47a1695196.plain: This power's range is Synaptic Link range or 24".

0a7add5ff31f.name: Relentless Hunger
0a7add5ff31f.plain: If a charge by a unit with this adaptation fails, that unit may make a Normal Move of up to 3".

0bec7c29aa34.name: Stabilising Membranes
0bec7c29aa34.plain: When a model with this adaptation makes a ranged attack, an unmodified wound roll of 6 improves that attack's Armour Penetration by 1.

0d20245b77ab.name: Hypertoxic Poison Cloud
0d20245b77ab.plain: At the end of the Fight phase, for each enemy model within Engagement Range of this model, roll one D6: on a 5+, the unit that model belongs to takes 1 mortal wound.

1003bf96bfa8.name: Endless Regeneration
1003bf96bfa8.plain: At the start of the Command phase, this WARLORD may regenerate, getting back up to D3 lost wounds. It can't do this more than once per turn.

116c07214d5b.name: Tyrant Goading
116c07214d5b.plain: Models in this unit get 1 added to their Attacks characteristic while the unit is within 3" of any <HIVE FLEET> HIVE TYRANT models from your army.

1309f4799547.name: Restrictions
1309f4799547.plain:
Your army must be all TYRANIDS from one <HIVE FLEET>, with no SWARM units, no models with 2 Wounds or fewer, and a MONSTER unit for every non-MONSTER unit.
• No SWARM units, and no models whose Wounds characteristic is 2 or less.
• For each unit in your army that lacks the MONSTER keyword, your army needs at least one MONSTER unit.
• Every unit in your army needs the TYRANIDS keyword and must come from the same <HIVE FLEET>.

132d594b82e7.name: Chitin Thorns
132d594b82e7.plain: Whenever this model makes a melee attack, that attack's Armour Penetration is improved by 1.

137c95e01774.name: Hive Nexus
137c95e01774.plain: Blessing: choose one of your CORE LEVIATHAN units within Synaptic Link range of this PSYKER, and one of your LEVIATHAN SYNAPSE models that is also within Synaptic Link range of this PSYKER, then choose one of that model's Synaptic Imperative abilities. Until your next turn begins, the chosen unit benefits from that SYNAPSE model's Synaptic Imperative as if it were in effect for your army, in addition to the one your army already has active, and as if the unit and the model were within 6" of each other.

148f1bd052e5.name: Death from Below
148f1bd052e5.plain: At deployment, you may place this unit underground instead of on the battlefield. If you do, you can later set it up during the Reinforcements step of any one of your Movement phases, anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from every enemy model.

14a80cbb01c6.name: Foul Spores (Aura)
14a80cbb01c6.plain: Aura: while one of your <HIVE FLEET> units (other than TITANIC units) is within 6" of this unit, subtract 1 from the hit roll of each ranged attack made against that unit.

14eb3a061f49.name: Encircle the Prey
14eb3a061f49.plain: Use at the end of your Movement phase. Pick one of your BURROWERS units, or one of your units that can FLY, and take it off the battlefield. You can set it back up in the Reinforcements step of your next Movement phase, anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy models. If it still isn't on the battlefield when the battle ends, it is destroyed. A unit that was set up on the battlefield this turn can't be picked.

15abd2a5fab7.name: Terrifying Charge
15abd2a5fab7.plain: Use at the start of the Morale phase. Pick an enemy unit that is within Engagement Range of one of your CRUSHER STAMPEDE MONSTER models which made a charge move this turn. For the rest of the turn, models in that enemy unit have 3 subtracted from their Leadership characteristic.

16f1cd84921c.name: Float Down (Meiotic Spores)
16f1cd84921c.plain: During deployment, you can place this unit in the upper atmosphere rather than on the battlefield. If you do, you can set it up in the Reinforcements step of your Movement phase, anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" away from any enemy models.

177057384858.name: Power of the Hive Mind
177057384858.plain: Use in your Psychic phase. Pick one of your HIVE TENDRIL PSYKER CHARACTER units. For the rest of the phase, it can attempt to manifest one extra psychic power.

1966623e0b02.name: Buried in Wait
1966623e0b02.plain: Use before the battle, in the Declare Reserves and Transports step (or during deployment, if your mission has no such step). Pick one JORMUNGANDR unit from your army (excluding TITANIC units). You can place it near to the surface instead of on the battlefield. If you do, you can set it up in the Reinforcements step of one of your Movement phases, anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" away from any enemy models. You can use this Stratagem only once, or twice in a Strike Force battle, or three times in an Onslaught battle.

1a106bfcfa53.name: Enhanced Toxic Miasma
1a106bfcfa53.plain: When the Fight phase ends, make a separate D6 roll for each enemy unit in Engagement Range of this model: each unit that gets a 4+ takes D3 mortal wounds.

1a315ced7981.name: Psychotropic Venom
1a315ced7981.plain: Use at the start of the Morale phase. Pick an enemy unit, other than a VEHICLE unit, that is within Engagement Range of one of your LASH WHIP or TOXIC LASHES units. For the rest of the phase, that enemy unit's models have their Leadership characteristic reduced by 2, and you subtract 1 from any Combat Attrition test taken for it.

1a32cbb4d9a8.name: Synaptic Channelling
1a32cbb4d9a8.plain: Use in your Psychic phase. Pick one of your <HIVE FLEET> PSYKER units. For the rest of the phase, it knows every psychic power that is known by friendly <HIVE FLEET> PSYKER units on the battlefield.

1adae71e1af1.name: Thresher Scythe
1adae71e1af1.plain: Each time the bearer fights, it makes 3 extra attacks with this weapon, and it can't make more than 3 attacks with this weapon in that fight.

1c65001f1902.name: Impaling Hooks
1c65001f1902.plain: Use in the Fight phase, when one of your FLESH HOOKS units is chosen to fight. For the rest of the phase, add 1 to the hit roll of each melee attack a FLESH HOOKS model in that unit makes against an enemy unit, unless that enemy unit is a VEHICLE or MONSTER unit.

1f4139f300da.name: Adaptive (Hydra)
1f4139f300da.plain: Models with this adaptation add 1" to their Move characteristic, and their consolidation moves can go up to 3" further than normal (to a maximum of 9").

1f778491c10b.name: It's Out There (Aura)
1f778491c10b.plain: Aura: enemy units within 6" of this model can't start to perform actions.

1fc6ebaeedbd.name: Vicious Devourers
1fc6ebaeedbd.plain: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for melee attacks by this unit's models, as long as the attacking model has no ranged weapons.

2010e251d19a.name: Lethal Miasma
2010e251d19a.plain: At the start of the Fight phase, roll one D6 per enemy unit within 3" of this WARLORD: a 2-5 deals 1 mortal wound to that unit, and a 6 deals D3 mortal wounds.

2058c383c88a.name: Synaptic Enhancement
2058c383c88a.plain: This model gains the Shadow in the Warp and Synapse abilities and the SYNAPSE keyword.

waive.86: page reference to the codex, not part of the rule

2121eceb6ce6.name: Hulking Behemoths
2121eceb6ce6.plain:
This unit gets a 5+ invulnerable save, takes less damage from each attack and counts as more models on objectives, but can never gain a Hive Fleet Adaptation.
• It can never gain a Hive Fleet Adaptation.
• Its models have a 5+ invulnerable save.
• Whenever an attack is allocated to one of its models, that attack's Damage characteristic is reduced by 1 (to a minimum of 1).
• When working out who controls an objective marker, each of its models counts as a number of models equal to its remaining wounds.

22dffe632e23.name: Synaptic Control
22dffe632e23.plain:
Some unmodified wound rolls against units with this adaptation always fail, whatever abilities the weapon or the attacker has.
• Against SYNAPSE MONSTER units, an unmodified wound roll of 1-3 always fails.
• Against non-SYNAPSE units that are within Synaptic Link range of any of your LEVIATHAN SYNAPSE units, an unmodified wound roll of 1-2 always fails.

23088a1e90e5.name: Exoskeletal Reinforcement
23088a1e90e5.plain: Attacks with an Armour Penetration of -1 that are allocated to models with this adaptation count as having an Armour Penetration of 0 instead.

234229391f0d.name: Alpha Leader
234229391f0d.plain: In your Command phase, pick one of your <HIVE FLEET> CARNIFEX models within 9" of this model. Until your next Command phase starts, add 1 to the hit roll whenever that model makes an attack.

25040e401cec.name: Floating Death
25040e401cec.plain: Whenever a model in this unit finishes a move within 3" of any enemy units, or when an enemy unit finishes a move during which one or more of its models came within 3" of a model in this unit, that model of yours can explode. An exploding model is destroyed; pick one of those enemy units and roll a D6: on a 2-4, the picked unit takes D6 mortal wounds; on a 5+, it takes D3+3 mortal wounds.

259b97b585b8.name: Lashwhip Pods
259b97b585b8.plain: Whenever the bearer fights, it gets 10 extra attacks with this weapon, and it can't make more than 10 attacks with this weapon.

26cddf5a464d.name: Preceptic Node
26cddf5a464d.plain: Whenever an enemy unit is placed on the battlefield as Reinforcements within 18" of the bearer during the Reinforcements step of your opponent's Movement phase, you can choose one of your LEVIATHAN CORE or LEVIATHAN CHARACTER units within 6" of the bearer. That unit may then shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, targeting only that enemy Reinforcements unit. No unit can be chosen to shoot more than once per phase through this Relic.

2a94620fd6f9.name: Volatile
2a94620fd6f9.plain: Roll one D6 each time a model in this unit is destroyed, before taking it off the battlefield. On a 6 the model explodes and every unit within 3" takes 1 mortal wound.

2ad68268fca9.name: Death Throes (3"/3)
2ad68268fca9.plain: When this model is destroyed, before you remove it, roll one D6. On a 6+, the nearest enemy unit within 3" takes 3 mortal wounds.

2ce661cd231d.name: Thunderous Impact
2ce661cd231d.plain: Use in the Fight phase, when one of your CRUSHER STAMPEDE MONSTER models has completed a pile-in move. Pick an enemy MONSTER or VEHICLE unit within Engagement Range of it. For the rest of the phase, that model can only attack the picked unit, and every attack it makes gets 1 added to its hit roll, 1 added to its wound roll and 1 added to its damage roll.

2d17713b7415.name: Symbiotic Targeting
2d17713b7415.plain: If this model Remains Stationary in your Movement phase, or moves less than half its Move characteristic in total, then until the end of the turn the target of each of its ranged attacks gets no benefit from cover against that attack.

2d2e34c88d8a.name: Infused Energies
2d2e34c88d8a.plain: Blessing: pick one of your CRUSHER STAMPEDE units within 18" of this PSYKER, other than a SYNAPSE unit. Until your next Psychic phase starts, you can re-roll the hit roll whenever a model in that unit makes a melee attack.

2eec8ccd43d4.name: Adaptive (Behemoth)
2eec8ccd43d4.plain: Your units with this adaptation can re-roll their charge rolls.

3017176fee2b.name: Terror from the Deep
3017176fee2b.plain: In your Command phase, if any of your MAWLOC models are underground (via the Death from Below ability), you can pick one of them and place a Terror from the Deep marker on any one point of the battlefield. If you do, that model can't be set up with Death from Below this turn. Instead, at the start of the Reinforcements step of the Movement phase in your next turn, roll one D6 for each enemy unit within 6" of the marker's centre. Add 1 to the roll if that unit has between 6 and 10 models, or add 2 if it has 11 or more models. On a 3-6, the unit takes D3 mortal wounds; on a 7+, it takes D3+3 mortal wounds. Then set up that MAWLOC anywhere on the battlefield within 12" of the marker's centre and not within Engagement Range of any enemy models, and remove the marker. If the MAWLOC is set up within 9" of any enemy models, it can't charge until the end of the turn.

waive.86: page number in a cross-reference remark ("see ... page 86"), not part of the rule

3036c2840d14.name: Psychic Shriek
3036c2840d14.plain: Witchfire: pick one enemy unit that is either within Synaptic Link range of this PSYKER or within 18" of this PSYKER. Roll one D6 for every one of your HYDRA INFANTRY and HYDRA BEAST models within 3" of that unit, and three D6 for every one of your HYDRA MONSTER models within 3" of it. Each 5+ inflicts 1 mortal wound on that enemy unit, up to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds.

30696913f644.name: Hardened Biology
30696913f644.plain: Against any attack whose Damage characteristic is 1, add 1 to armour saving throws made for this model once that attack is allocated to it.

31952b97c929.name: Tentaclids
31952b97c929.plain: When this weapon attacks a VEHICLE unit, an unmodified wound roll of 4+ always wounds. Attacks made with this weapon that are allocated to an AIRCRAFT model have a Damage characteristic of 4.

31f55c03c1df.name: Encephalic Diffusion
31f55c03c1df.plain: This unit can attempt the following psychic action. Encephalic Diffusion (Psychic Action - Warp Charge 6): this PSYKER can attempt it in your Psychic phase. If it is completed, this PSYKER has the following ability until your next Psychic phase starts: 'Diffusion Field (Aura): while one of your <HIVE FLEET> units is within 6" of this PSYKER, subtract 1 from the Strength characteristic of each ranged attack made against that unit.'

322d18110328.name: Voracious Appetite
322d18110328.plain: Use in the Fight phase, when one of your HIVE TENDRIL MONSTER models is chosen to fight. For the rest of the phase, you can re-roll the wound roll for each melee attack it makes.

329702713d76.name: Bounding Advance
329702713d76.plain: Use in your Movement phase, when one of your HORMAGAUNTS units is chosen to Advance. Until the end of the turn: whenever that unit Advances, don't make an Advance roll; instead, its models add 6" to their Move characteristic until the end of the phase. The unit can also still declare a charge this turn even though it Advanced. Cost: 1CP if the unit has 15 or fewer models, otherwise 2CP.

33557d7d90f7.name: Territorial Instincts
33557d7d90f7.plain: Each MONSTER model with this adaptation has Objective Secured. If its Wounds characteristic is 10 or more, it also counts as 5 models when working out who controls an objective marker.

33929bbadf63.name: Barbworm Infestation
33929bbadf63.plain: Whenever the bearer makes a ranged attack, you can re-roll its wound roll.

33ba42da0770.name: Domination of the Hive Mind
33ba42da0770.plain: In your Command phase, pick one of your <HIVE FLEET> CORE units within Synaptic Link range of this model. Until your next Command phase starts, re-roll the hit roll whenever a model in that unit makes an attack.

waive.87: page reference to the codex, not part of the rule

348811df4c5e.name: Shadow in the Warp (Aura)
348811df4c5e.plain: Aura: for any enemy PSYKER unit within 18" of this unit, Psychic tests it takes are reduced by 1, and every time it suffers Perils of the Warp it takes 1 more mortal wound than normal.

37c3a6ee874c.name: Synaptic Hive Blades
37c3a6ee874c.plain: Model with boneswords or monstrous boneswords only: your opponent can't make invulnerable saving throws against the bearer's melee attacks with those weapons.

37df11df9a3d.name: Float Down
37df11df9a3d.plain: During deployment, you can place this unit in the upper atmosphere rather than on the battlefield. If you do, you can set it up in the Reinforcements step of one of your Movement phases, anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" away from any enemy models.

3896c6e521b1.name: Animated by the Hive Mind
3896c6e521b1.plain: Use in any phase, when one of your LEVIATHAN MONSTER models (excluding TITANIC models) is destroyed. If it has an ability triggered by a dice roll on its destruction (such as Death Throes), skip that roll: the ability triggers automatically.

38efd11ff722.name: Adaptive Neural Lobe
38efd11ff722.plain: Whenever your opponent pays a Command Point for a Stratagem while the bearer is on the battlefield, you may roll one D6; a 5+ gets you 1 Command Point.

38f37c8939ff.name: One Step Ahead
38f37c8939ff.plain: If this WARLORD is on the battlefield when your opponent uses a Stratagem, roll one D6; a 5+ gives you 1 Command point.

3a17dba2b2d8.name: *Designers Note
3a17dba2b2d8.plain: If this model has no base, both players must agree on the footprint of its 'base' before deployment, the same way they would for an Area Terrain feature. The suggested method is to imagine straight lines drawn from each point of the model that would touch the battlefield if it stood on a flat surface; the area inside those lines is treated as the model's 'base'. If the model is posed with one or more legs raised, agree with your opponent where each raised leg would touch the battlefield, and use those points to help define the shape of the model's 'base'.

3a3be2e4e24b.name: Heightened Senses
3a3be2e4e24b.plain: You can re-roll this WARLORD's hit rolls, and it can fight first in the Fight phase if within Engagement Range of any enemy units as the phase starts.

3a7500a819fd.name: Floating Death
3a7500a819fd.plain: Whenever a model in this unit finishes a move within 3" of any enemy units, or when an enemy unit finishes a move during which one or more of its models came within 3" of a model in this unit, that model of yours can explode. An exploding model is destroyed; pick one of those enemy units and roll a D6: on a 2-4, the picked unit takes 1 mortal wound; on a 5+, it takes D3 mortal wounds.

3e302989e01e.name: Spore Mine Launcher
3e302989e01e.plain: This weapon can target units the bearer can't see, as long as a friendly <HIVE FLEET> SYNAPSE model can see them. If an attack with this weapon scores a hit, the target takes 1 mortal wound and the attack sequence ends.

3efe187509bd.name: Adaptive (Kronos)
3efe187509bd.plain: Ranged attacks by models with this adaptation improve their Armour Penetration by 1 against targets within half range.

3f5b5756910a.name: Broodlord
3f5b5756910a.plain: This model knows Smite and 1 psychic power from the Hive Mind discipline.

3f801ceffdb0.name: Soul Hunger (Aura)
3f801ceffdb0.plain: Aura: an enemy PSYKER unit within 18" of this WARLORD suffers Perils of the Warp on any double in a Psychic test, not just a double 1 or double 6.

3fe1ab765b63.name: Airborne
3fe1ab765b63.plain: You can't declare a charge with this model, and only a unit that can FLY can pick it as a charge target. This model can fight only while it is within Engagement Range of enemy units that can FLY, and it can make melee attacks only against enemy units that can FLY. Enemy units without FLY can't make melee attacks against it.

41776a61d84e.name: Death Surge
41776a61d84e.plain: Use in the Fight phase, when a CRUSHER STAMPEDE MONSTER model from your army (excluding CHARACTER models) is destroyed. Don't remove it from play: it can fight once the attacking model's unit has finished making attacks. While doing so, that CRUSHER STAMPEDE model is treated as having all its wounds remaining when working out which characteristics on its profile to use. After its attacks are resolved, remove it.

4276e3edc294.name: Death from Above
4276e3edc294.plain: At deployment, you may place this model high in the skies instead of on the battlefield. If you do, you can later set it up during the Reinforcements step of any one of your Movement phases, anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from every enemy model; for the rest of that turn, charge rolls for this model can be re-rolled.

42a8726a8ed2.name: Bio-impulses
42a8726a8ed2.plain: In your Command phase, pick one of your <HIVE FLEET> CORE units within Synaptic Link range of this model that hasn't yet been picked for this ability this turn. Until your next Command phase starts, add 1 to that unit's Advance rolls and add 1 to its charge rolls.

waive.87: page reference to the codex, not part of the rule

43c27af7fbb9.name: Lesser Organisms
43c27af7fbb9.plain: If your army is Battle-forged, this unit can't fill a compulsory Battlefield Role slot in a Detachment.

44620483cdf7.name: Exoskeletal Stabilisation
44620483cdf7.plain: Models with this adaptation ignore the hit roll penalty for firing Assault weapons in a turn their unit Advanced, and Heavy weapons in a turn it moved. MONSTER models with this adaptation also ignore the hit roll penalty for firing Heavy weapons at enemy units within Engagement Range of them.

44fba35f1d3a.name: The Passenger
44fba35f1d3a.plain: ADRENAL GLANDS models only. Add 2 to the bearer's Advance rolls and add 2 to its charge rolls.

485e61524fbb.name: Defensive Stance
485e61524fbb.plain: This unit can perform the Defensive Stance action. Any number of your HIVE GUARD units can begin it at the start of your Command phase, and it completes at the end of your next Movement phase. Once it completes, until the start of your next Movement phase, every model in this unit counts as 3 models when working out who controls an objective marker.

48f78be85b6e.name: Hyper-toxicity
48f78be85b6e.plain: Use in the Fight phase, when one of your GORGON TOXIN SACS units is chosen to fight. For the rest of the phase, melee attacks by TOXIN SACS models in that unit wound the target automatically on an unmodified hit roll of 5+.

49185cd54970.name: Swarming Masses
49185cd54970.plain: Each time this unit fights, a model in it can fight if it is within Engagement Range of any enemy units, or if it is within 2½ inches of any enemy units. However, if during the Fight phase this unit is affected by any other rule that would cut down the number of its models able to fight, then for that phase that other rule and Swarming Masses both have no effect.

4ab9354aaa58.name: Rapacious Hunger
4ab9354aaa58.plain: Whenever an attack made by this model destroys an enemy model, this model regains 1 lost wound, up to a maximum of 3 wounds regained per phase.

4aec0a439de1.name: Adrenal Surge
4aec0a439de1.plain: Use in the Fight phase, when one of your ADRENAL GLANDS units is chosen to fight. If that unit made a charge move this turn, then for the rest of the phase, its models (excluding MONSTER models) add 1 to their Attacks characteristic and its MONSTER models add D3 to theirs. Cost: 1CP if that unit has 19 or fewer models, otherwise 2CP.

4bbb468a447f.name: Impaler Cannon
4bbb468a447f.plain: This weapon can target units the bearer can't see, as long as a friendly <HIVE FLEET> SYNAPSE model can see the target. Targets of attacks made with this weapon get no benefit from Light Cover against those attacks.

4da912fa485f.name: Adaptive (Jormungandr)
4da912fa485f.plain: When a Blast weapon targets a unit with this adaptation, count half the unit's models (rounding up) when working out how many attacks that weapon makes.

4e445814182c.name: Vanguard Predator
4e445814182c.plain: When you deploy, you can set this unit up anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" away from both the enemy deployment zone and all enemy models.

4e850043114a.name: Alpha Leader-beast
4e850043114a.plain: Use before the battle, while mustering your army, after you nominate a LEVIATHAN CHARACTER model that isn't a named character as your WARLORD. You can generate one extra Warlord Trait for them from the Leviathan Warlord Traits table. Every Warlord Trait in your army must be unique (if rolling randomly, re-roll duplicates). You can use this Stratagem only once.

4eb1df1df8e0.name: Airborne Predator
4eb1df1df8e0.plain: When you declare a charge with this model, it can only target AIRCRAFT units. Only a unit that can FLY can pick this model as a charge target. This model can fight only while it is within Engagement Range of enemy units that can FLY, and it can make melee attacks only against units that can FLY. Enemy units without FLY can't make melee attacks against it.

5029a4841862.name: Lightning Reflexes (Genestealers)
5029a4841862.plain: Every model in this unit has a 5+ invulnerable save, improved to 4+ against melee attacks.

50eb157ed131.name: Leaper-killer
50eb157ed131.plain: This model has a 5+ invulnerable save. Also, while making a Normal Move, an Advance, a Fall Back or a charge move, it can move horizontally and vertically through models and terrain features until the move is over (but it cannot end a move on top of another model, or its base).

523256f49520.name: Spore Clouds
523256f49520.plain: Use in your Movement phase, when one of your SPORECASTER units is chosen to Remain Stationary. That unit's aura abilities have their range increased by 6" until the start of your next Command phase.

52a75e6c6990.name: Regeneration
52a75e6c6990.plain: In your Command phase, this model regenerates, regaining up to D3 lost wounds. A model can't be regenerated more than once per turn.

53eaf001d6cc.name: Toxic Entanglement
53eaf001d6cc.plain: Use in your Shooting phase, when one of your TOXICRENE models hits an enemy unit (other than an AIRCRAFT unit) with a ranged attack. Roll a D6. On a 2+, the following apply until the start of your next Movement phase: that enemy unit's models have their Move characteristic halved; if that enemy unit declares a charge, the TOXICRENE model must be one of its targets; and if the TOXICRENE model declares a charge, that enemy unit must be one of its targets, and you also add 2 to that charge roll.

558241baa38b.name: Blade Parry
558241baa38b.plain: Once per turn, the first time this model fails a saving throw against a melee attack, that attack's Damage characteristic becomes 0.

5645178abda6.name: Shadow Hunter
5645178abda6.plain: Subtract 1 from the hit roll of each attack made against this model, and that hit roll can't be re-rolled.

5693e3adc698.name: Poisonous Influence
5693e3adc698.plain: Blessing: pick one of your GORGON units within Synaptic Link range of this PSYKER. Until your next Psychic phase starts, whenever a model in that unit makes a melee attack and gets an unmodified wound roll of 6, the target suffers 1 mortal wound on top of the normal damage, up to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds.

589780153a51.name: Scorch Bugs
589780153a51.plain: Use in your Shooting phase, when one of your HIVE TENDRIL units is chosen to shoot. For the rest of the phase, fleshborer and fleshborer hive weapons carried by models in that unit get 6" added to their Range characteristic and 1 added to their Strength characteristic. Cost: 2CP if the unit has 16 or more models or has the MONSTER keyword, otherwise 1CP.

5a96dee7f6bd.name: Catalyst
5a96dee7f6bd.plain: Blessing: pick one of your <HIVE FLEET> units within Synaptic Link range of this PSYKER. Until your next Psychic phase starts, whenever a model in that unit would lose a wound, roll one D6: the wound is not lost on a 5+, or only on a 6 if that model is TITANIC.

5ad4061f4a6b.name: Hyper-adaptations
5ad4061f4a6b.plain: Every Hive Fleet Adaptation has an Adaptive part that you can swap for another rule at the start of the battle, once it's decided who has the first turn. Each hive fleet's Hyper-adaptations rule says which replacement rules you can pick from.

5b39f1d1b080.name: Critical Mass
5b39f1d1b080.plain: Use in the Fight phase, when one of your HYDRA units is chosen to fight. For the rest of the phase, when a model in that unit makes a melee attack against an enemy unit that has fewer models than the attacker's own unit, you can re-roll the wound roll.

5b6cb56269cc.name: Gargantuan Scything Talons
5b6cb56269cc.plain: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made with this weapon.

5c81aba8cc7e.name: Swooping Assault
5c81aba8cc7e.plain: During deployment, you can place this unit high in the skies rather than on the battlefield. If you do, you can set it up in the Reinforcements step of one of your Movement phases, anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" away from any enemy models.

5d828b4ec141.name: Pathogenesis
5d828b4ec141.plain: Ranged weapons the bearer is equipped with get 8" added to their Range characteristic. Whenever the bearer shoots, you can re-roll one hit roll and one wound roll while resolving those attacks.

5d8783ebb20a.name: Death Throes (2D6"/D6)
5d8783ebb20a.plain: When this model is destroyed, before you remove it, roll one D6. On a 6+, the nearest enemy unit within 2D6" takes D6 mortal wounds.

5de353d3bf69.name: Flesh Hooks
5de353d3bf69.plain: The bearer gets the FLESH HOOKS keyword. Whenever the bearer's unit makes a Normal Move, Advances or Falls Back, any vertical distance the bearer moves doesn't count towards how far it can move that turn.

5e0488fa68aa.name: Combined Assault
5e0488fa68aa.plain: Use in the Fight phase. Pick an enemy unit that two or more of your LEVIATHAN units are within Engagement Range of. For the rest of the phase, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic by 1 for each melee attack a LEVIATHAN model makes against that enemy unit.

5e12a1cc41af.name: Enraged Reserves
5e12a1cc41af.plain: If this model has characteristics that change as it is damaged, count its remaining wounds as doubled to decide what those characteristics are. Once per battle, when you choose this model for a Tyranids Epic Deed Stratagem, that use of the Stratagem costs no Command points. Using that Stratagem again later costs the usual number of CPs.

5e81ac1014ec.name: Subterranean Assault
5e81ac1014ec.plain: When one of your <HIVE FLEET> TRYGON or <HIVE FLEET> TRYGON PRIME models is set up on the battlefield in the Reinforcements step of your Movement phase using its Death From Below ability, you can use this Stratagem. Pick a friendly <HIVE FLEET> unit in Strategic Reserves whose Battlefield Role is Troops, and set it up wholly within 9" of the TRYGON or TRYGON PRIME model, anywhere on the battlefield but not within 9" of an enemy model.

5e83859c04a2.name: Splinter Fleet
5e83859c04a2.plain:
Pick one of these hive fleets and use its Hive Fleet Adaptation and Hyper-adaptation: Behemoth, Kraken, Leviathan, Gorgon, Jormungandr, Kronos or Hydra.
Warlord Trait: if a CHARACTER model with this adaptation gets a Warlord Trait, it can take the picked hive fleet's own Hive Fleet Warlord Trait instead of a normal Warlord Trait. If it does, every <HIVE FLEET> keyword on that trait (such as KRAKEN) becomes the name of the CHARACTER's own hive fleet.
Unless all your units with this adaptation are in Auxiliary Support, Super-heavy Auxiliary or Fortification Network Detachments (in any mix):
• You can use the picked hive fleet's Hive Fleet Stratagem. When you do, every <HIVE FLEET> keyword on it (such as KRAKEN) becomes the name of the hive fleet your units with this adaptation belong to.
• Your HIVE TENDRIL PSYKER units with this adaptation know that hive fleet's Hive Fleet psychic power on top of their other powers. When it is manifested, every <HIVE FLEET> keyword on it (such as KRAKEN) becomes the name of the hive fleet your units with this adaptation belong to.
