waive.59: page reference ("pages 53-59") to where the hive fleets' adaptations are printed; not part of the rule
waive.68: page reference ("page 68") to the standard Warlord Traits table; not part of the rule
waive.CHARCTER: typo in the official text for CHARACTER; the plain text uses the correctly spelled CHARACTER keyword

5f6d8b54e7f5.name: Fear of the Unseen
5f6d8b54e7f5.plain: While an enemy unit is within Engagement Range of this model, your opponent can't select that unit for Stratagems, and Stratagems your opponent uses can't affect that unit when it is selected to shoot or fight.

61049527ee91.name: Brood Progenitor
61049527ee91.plain: In your Command phase, pick one of your <HIVE FLEET> TERMAGANTS units within Synaptic Link range of this model that hasn't yet been picked for this ability this turn. Until your next Command phase starts, add 1 to the hit roll whenever a model in that unit makes a ranged attack.

waive.87: page reference to the codex, not part of the rule

61aa459ac5b1.name: Death Throes (6"/D3)
61aa459ac5b1.plain: Roll one D6 when this model is destroyed, before taking it off the battlefield: on a 6+, the nearest enemy unit within 6" takes D3 mortal wounds.

62e3977f1496.name: Aerial Seeding
62e3977f1496.plain: This model must be set up high in the skies during deployment, not on the battlefield. Neither it nor any units embarked in it count towards any mission limit on the maximum number of Reinforcement units in your army. In your first, second or third Movement phase, during the Reinforcements step and whatever the mission rules say, you can set up this TRANSPORT model anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" away from any enemy models. Units embarked in it must disembark as soon as it is set up, and must be placed more than 9" from all enemy models. Once this TRANSPORT model is on the battlefield, no models can embark in it.

62eb0f2fdfa2.name: Unstoppable Onslaught
62eb0f2fdfa2.plain: Blessing: choose one of your BEHEMOTH units within Synaptic Link range of this PSYKER. Its models add 1 to the wound roll of their melee attacks until your next turn begins.

64bd01c648b6.name: The Dirgeheart of Kharis
64bd01c648b6.plain: After the bearer resolves its attacks each time it is selected to fight, choose one enemy unit the bearer hit with an attack this phase. For the rest of this turn and all of the next turn, that unit loses the Objective Secured ability and its models have 1 subtracted from their Leadership characteristic.

64dfdf48b84c.name: Acidic Torrent
64dfdf48b84c.plain: Use in the Fight phase, when a unit of yours that contains any ACID MAW models is chosen to fight. Pick an enemy unit within Engagement Range of it. Roll a D6 for each ACID MAW INFANTRY model in your unit that is within Engagement Range of the picked enemy unit, or three D6 for such a model that has the MONSTER keyword. For each 3+, the enemy unit takes 1 mortal wound, up to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds.

66a0d8784d2f.name: Biostatic Rattle
66a0d8784d2f.plain: When the Fight phase starts, pick one enemy unit within Engagement Range of the bearer and roll 3D6. If the total is higher than that unit's Leadership characteristic, then until the phase ends, hit rolls and wound rolls can't be re-rolled for attacks made by models in that unit.

66deb495972c.name: Adaptive Toxins
66deb495972c.plain: Attacks by models with this adaptation always wound on an unmodified wound roll of 4+, unless the target is a VEHICLE or TITANIC unit.

66f61ea0318a.name: Scythes of Tyran
66f61ea0318a.plain: Only for a model that has 2 monstrous scything talons. This Relic takes the place of those 2 monstrous scything talons.

68d98117de5e.name: Massive Scything Sickle-talons
68d98117de5e.plain: You can re-roll the hit roll for attacks made with this weapon.

68e3e4d5e17e.name: Neuroparasite
68e3e4d5e17e.plain: Witchfire: pick one enemy unit that is either within Synaptic Link range of this PSYKER or within 18" of it. Roll one D6 per model in that unit; each roll higher than that model's Toughness characteristic causes 1 mortal wound to that unit, up to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds.

waive.PSTKER: misspelling of PSYKER in the official text; written correctly as PSYKER

6e0222c84a0e.name: Synaptic Lynchpin
6e0222c84a0e.plain: This WARLORD's aura abilities and Synaptic Imperative abilities get 3" more range. In addition, whenever it uses an ability with a stated range in your Command phase, that ability's range is 3" longer until the end of the phase.

waive.88: page reference ("pg 88") to where the Synaptic Imperative abilities are printed; not part of the rule

6e9058c5f439.name: Savage Intimidation (Aura)
6e9058c5f439.plain: Aura: enemy units within 6" of this WARLORD subtract 1 from their melee hit rolls and 1 from their Combat Attrition tests.

6f9519be6ee3.name: Synaptic Domination
6f9519be6ee3.plain: Use in your Psychic phase. Pick one of your LEVIATHAN SYNAPSE units and one of your LEVIATHAN non-SYNAPSE units. Until the start of your next Psychic phase, as long as the SYNAPSE unit you picked is on the battlefield, the non-SYNAPSE unit always counts as within its range for the Synapse and Instinctive Behaviour abilities.

6ff9fb135559.name: Endless Swarm
6ff9fb135559.plain: Use at the start of your Command phase. Pick one of your ENDLESS MULTITUDE units. You can return up to D3+3 of its destroyed models to it, each with its full wounds. The returned models may only be set up within Engagement Range of enemy units already within Engagement Range of the unit they are rejoining.

701927866d94.name: Hyper Adaptation
701927866d94.plain: Use in your Command phase. Pick one LEVIATHAN unit from your army and one Hive Fleet Adaptation. Until the end of the turn, that unit's models have the chosen Hive Fleet Adaptation in place of the Synaptic Imperative Hive Fleet Adaptation.

7072d0dfefcb.name: Adrenal Glands
7072d0dfefcb.plain: The bearer gets the ADRENAL GLANDS keyword. Its Move characteristic is increased by 1" and its Strength characteristic is increased by 1.

71b42dfe9096.name: Psybrood Coterie
71b42dfe9096.plain: If your army is Battle-forged, each Detachment that contains any <HIVE FLEET> NEUROTHROPE units can also include one <HIVE FLEET> ZOANTHROPE unit that doesn't take up a Battlefield Role slot.

71da2ad94d1e.name: Trampling Charge
71da2ad94d1e.plain: Use in your Charge phase, when one of your HIVE TENDRIL MONSTER models finishes a charge move. Pick an enemy unit within Engagement Range of that MONSTER model and roll a D6. If the MONSTER model has the HORNED CHITIN keyword: on a 2-4 the enemy unit takes 3 mortal wounds, and on a 5+ it takes D3+3 mortal wounds. If it doesn't have the HORNED CHITIN keyword: on a 2-4 the enemy unit takes D3 mortal wounds, and on a 5+ it takes 3 mortal wounds.

71e75f978d0c.name: Bio-adapted Borer Grubs
71e75f978d0c.plain: Use in your Shooting phase, when one of your LEVIATHAN units is chosen to shoot. For the rest of the phase, when a model in that unit attacks with a fleshborer or fleshborer hive, an unmodified wound roll of 6 inflicts 1 mortal wound on the target on top of the normal damage (no more than 6 mortal wounds per phase from this Stratagem). Cost: 2CP if that unit is a TYRANNOFEX, otherwise 1CP. You can't use both this Stratagem and the Scorch Bugs Stratagem on the same unit in the same phase.

730585eb1c24.name: Tunnel Networks
730585eb1c24.plain: Units with this adaptation get the benefits of Dense Cover against ranged attacks from more than 12" away, or from more than 18" away for MONSTER units.

waive.40000: part of the book title "Warhammer 40,000 Core Book" in a cross-reference, which the style guide says to leave out

7405dc59a09d.name: Floating Death (Meiotic Spores)
7405dc59a09d.plain: At the end of the Charge phase, any model in this unit that is within 3" of any enemy units explodes. For each Meiotic Spore that explodes, roll one D6: on a 2-3, the nearest enemy unit takes D3 mortal wounds; on a 4+, it takes 3 mortal wounds. The exploding Meiotic Spore model is then destroyed.

743e2788e738.name: Digestion Spine
743e2788e738.plain: If this model's Thorax Spine-maw ability destroys any enemy models, then when the turn ends this model has the following ability for the rest of the battle: 'Regenerative Physiology: roll one D6 each time this model would lose a wound; on a 5+, it doesn't lose that wound.'

754b4ba8b244.name: Nullnode
754b4ba8b244.plain: In your Command phase, pick one enemy unit within Synaptic Link range of the bearer. Until your next Command phase starts, hit rolls and wound rolls can't be re-rolled for attacks made by models in that unit, and Psychic tests taken for that unit can't be re-rolled.

waive.87: page reference to the codex, not part of the rule

7581f9d7b1da.name: Corrosive Viscera
7581f9d7b1da.plain: Use in the Fight phase, when a model in one of your ACID BLOOD units would lose a wound. For the rest of the phase, whenever a model in that unit would lose a wound because of a melee attack, roll a D6: on a 4+, once the attacking model's unit has made all of its attacks, it takes 1 mortal wound (to a maximum of 6 mortal wounds).

773eb4210295.name: Onslaught
773eb4210295.plain: Blessing: pick one of your <HIVE FLEET> units within Synaptic Link range of this PSYKER. Until your next Psychic phase starts, its models ignore the hit roll penalty for firing Assault weapons in a turn their unit Advanced and the hit roll penalty for firing Heavy weapons in a turn their unit moved, and the unit can declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.

7795c098df6c.name: Rapid Adaptation
7795c098df6c.plain: Use before the battle, while mustering your army. Pick one CRUSHER STAMPEDE TYRANID WARRIORS unit from your army. Its models have Weapon Skill 2+ and Ballistic Skill 3+. You can use this Stratagem only once, or twice in a Strike Force battle, or three times in an Onslaught battle.

78a6927a761a.name: Massive Grasping Tendrils
78a6927a761a.plain: Once per turn, this model can use this ability when an enemy unit in its Engagement Range is chosen to Fall Back, unless that unit is an AIRCRAFT unit. Roll one D6, and add 1 to the roll if the enemy unit has the INFANTRY keyword: on a 3+, it can't Fall Back and has to Remain Stationary instead.

78b790baa5b9.name: Alpha Warrior
78b790baa5b9.plain: In your Command phase, choose a <HIVE FLEET> CORE unit from your army that is within Synaptic Link range of this model and hasn't been chosen for this ability yet this turn. Until your next Command phase begins, wound rolls of 1 are re-rolled for attacks made by that unit's models.

waive.87: page reference to the codex, not part of the rule

798eb7145007.name: Parasitic Infection
798eb7145007.plain: When an attack with this weapon wounds an enemy unit that isn't a VEHICLE unit, that unit takes 1 mortal wound in addition to any normal damage and is now infected with parasites. At the start of your opponent's Command phase, your opponent must roll a D6 for every enemy unit infected with parasites: on a 1-3, the unit takes D3 mortal wounds and stops being infected; on a 4-6, it takes D3 mortal wounds and is still infected. If a unit takes 2 or more mortal wounds from this ability in that phase, you set up a new <HIVE FLEET> RIPPER SWARMS unit of yours on the battlefield within 3" of it but not within Engagement Range of any enemy units. That new RIPPER SWARMS unit has 1 model and, in games with a points limit, it costs no Reinforcement points.

7a3b62f7d875.name: Berserk Rampage
7a3b62f7d875.plain: Whenever this model fights in a turn in which it made a charge move or performed a Heroic Intervention, add D3+1 to its Attacks characteristic until that fight is resolved.

7cb13de4f10e.name: Adaptive (Gorgon)
7cb13de4f10e.plain: Each time a unit with this adaptation is chosen to shoot or fight, you may re-roll a single wound roll from that unit's attacks.

7d3f63f55dbf.name: Vicious Hunter
7d3f63f55dbf.plain: When this model makes a ranged attack, the target gets no benefit from Light Cover against it, and an unmodified wound roll of 6 improves that attack's Armour Penetration characteristic by 1.

7e726d2b3044.name: Augmented Ferocity
7e726d2b3044.plain: Units with this adaptation add 1 to their charge rolls.

7e9788a53504.name: The Reaper of Obilterax
7e9788a53504.plain: Only for a model equipped with a bonesword or monstrous bonesword. That weapon gains these abilities: whenever an attack made with it wounds the target, the target also suffers 1 mortal wound on top of any other damage, up to a maximum of 3 mortal wounds; and whenever an attack made with it is allocated to an enemy model, that model can't use any rules to ignore the wounds it loses.

800fc4717986.name: Psychic Overload
800fc4717986.plain: If the Psychic test for a psychic power this model successfully manifests, or for a psychic action it completes, was 7 or more, then once that psychic power is resolved, the nearest enemy unit within 12" takes mortal wounds equal to the number given in the table that goes with this ability.

81e4243270e2.name: Spirit Leech
81e4243270e2.plain: During your Psychic phase, whenever a mortal wound is suffered by an enemy unit within 18" of this model, choose a <HIVE FLEET> NEUROTHROPE or <HIVE FLEET> ZOANTHROPE model from your army within 12" of this model; it regains 1 lost wound (3 regained wounds per phase at most).

82f9568e1753.name: Superior Chameleonic Skin
82f9568e1753.plain: Subtract 1 from the hit roll of every attack made against this model. While this model is receiving the benefits of cover, it can't be chosen as the target of a ranged attack by an attacker more than 12" away. This model has a 4+ invulnerable save.

83d690daee8b.name: Guardian Organism
83d690daee8b.plain: If a <HIVE FLEET> HIVE TYRANT model from your army is within 3" of this unit, that HIVE TYRANT may use the Look Out, Sir rule even when this unit has fewer than 3 models. HIVE TYRANTS within this ability's range benefit from Look Out, Sir despite being Character units whose Wounds characteristic is more than 9.

83eee6cfa4fa.name: Broodlord Claws and Talons
83eee6cfa4fa.plain: You can re-roll the wound roll for attacks made with this weapon, and an attack with an unmodified wound roll of 6 has an AP characteristic of -5.

8496692b036c.name: The Void in the Warp
8496692b036c.plain: Use in your opponent's Psychic phase, once an enemy PSYKER unit has passed a Psychic test and any Deny the Witch attempt has been made. If any of your LEVIATHAN SYNAPSE units are within 24" of that PSYKER unit, roll a D6: on a 4+, the psychic power is denied.

865b2a8a83df.name: Aggressive Surge
865b2a8a83df.plain: Blessing: pick one of your CRUSHER STAMPEDE models within 18" of this PSYKER. Until your next Psychic phase starts, that model's Attacks characteristic is increased by D3.

86f4abebcf1c.name: Gestalt Commander
86f4abebcf1c.plain: At the start of each battle round, pick a Hive Fleet Warlord Trait for this WARLORD; it has that trait until the next battle round starts. You can't pick Perfectly Adapted, or any Warlord Trait a model in your army already has. Replace any hive fleet keyword in the chosen trait with LEVIATHAN.

8804109824fe.name: Hive Mind Imperative
8804109824fe.plain: Use in your Command phase. Pick one of your LEVIATHAN units that is within 12" of a friendly LEVIATHAN SYNAPSE unit. The following apply until the start of your next Command phase: the picked unit gains the Objective Secured ability, and if a model in it already has that ability, it counts as one extra model when determining control of an objective marker; and if the picked unit performs an action, it can shoot without that action failing.

8947c5f13c78.name: Synaptic Guidance
8947c5f13c78.plain: If a model in this unit targets an enemy unit with a ranged attack, and a friendly <HIVE FLEET> SYNAPSE model can see that enemy unit, you can ignore any or all modifiers to that attack's hit roll and to Ballistic Skill.

8ace63b7ece5.name: Shockcannon
8ace63b7ece5.plain: When this weapon attacks a VEHICLE unit, an unmodified wound roll of 4+ always wounds and also inflicts 1 mortal wound on top of any normal damage.

8b10b023c989.name: Adaptive (Leviathan)
8b10b023c989.plain: Each time a unit with this adaptation is chosen to shoot or fight, you may re-roll a single hit roll from that unit's attacks.

8b9db01f3bd6.name: Hypertoxic Miasma
8b9db01f3bd6.plain: When the Fight phase starts, roll one D6 for every enemy unit within Engagement Range of this model. On a 4+, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds and can't fight this phase until all eligible units from your army have fought.

8bca2d5e5e7a.name: Balethorn Cannon
8bca2d5e5e7a.plain: Only a model equipped with a stranglethorn cannon can have this Relic, and it takes the place of that stranglethorn cannon.

8be7a23ce708.name: Enhanced Brain Functions
8be7a23ce708.plain: Use in your Shooting phase. Pick one of your CRUSHER STAMPEDE TYRANID WARRIORS units that is within Engagement Range of any enemy models. For the rest of the phase, its models can use the Big Guns Never Tire rule to make ranged attacks as though they had the MONSTER keyword. Cost: 1CP if the unit has 5 or fewer models, otherwise 2CP.

8c0eb314e57d.name: Chameleonic Mutation
8c0eb314e57d.plain: Whenever an attack is made against the bearer, subtract 1 from its hit roll, and that hit roll can't be re-rolled.

8c1b34344149.name: Infrasonic Roar
8c1b34344149.plain: When your Movement phase ends, choose an enemy unit within 12" of the bearer, then roll 3D6. If the total is at least that unit's Leadership characteristic, it can't perform actions until your next Movement phase begins, and any action it is in the middle of fails at once.

8e4defea1153.name: Swarm Leader
8e4defea1153.plain: In your Command phase, pick one of your LEVIATHAN INFANTRY, LEVIATHAN BEAST or LEVIATHAN SWARM units within 9" of this WARLORD to re-roll hit rolls. The re-roll is available for every attack its models make until your next Command phase starts.

8e5737b219b5.name: Grasping Tongue
8e5737b219b5.plain: When choosing targets for this weapon, the Look Out, Sir rule can be ignored.

8eb1ba281bc5.name: Hidden Hunter
8eb1ba281bc5.plain: At deployment, you may hide this model instead of placing it on the battlefield. If you do, during the Reinforcements step of any one of your Movement phases you can set it up wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge or of any terrain feature, and more than 9" from every enemy model (or only more than 6" from enemy models if it is set up wholly inside your deployment zone). For the rest of that turn, charge rolls for this model can be re-rolled.

8eb532052197.name: Grasping Tendrils
8eb532052197.plain: Once per turn, this unit can use this ability when an enemy unit in its Engagement Range is chosen to Fall Back, unless that unit is a MONSTER or VEHICLE unit. Roll one D6: on a 4+, it can't Fall Back and has to Remain Stationary instead.

8ec093ff0e65.name: Shrouding Spores (Aura)
8ec093ff0e65.plain: Aura: while one of your <HIVE FLEET> units that isn't TITANIC is within 6" of this model, subtract 1 from the hit roll of each ranged attack made against that unit.

8f1222b7ddda.name: The Ymgarl Factor
8f1222b7ddda.plain: When the Fight phase starts, choose one of these effects for the bearer, lasting until the phase ends: add 2 to its Strength characteristic; add 1 to its Attacks characteristic; or add 1 to its Toughness characteristic.

8fa1e54f780a.name: Warp Siphon
8fa1e54f780a.plain: In your Command phase, pick one of your <HIVE FLEET> PSYKER units within Synaptic Link range of this model that hasn't yet been picked for this ability this turn. Until your next Command phase starts, whenever a Psychic test is taken for that unit, roll an extra D6 and then discard one of the dice.

waive.87: page reference to the codex, not part of the rule

8fb316ef8e41.name: Spore Mine Cysts
8fb316ef8e41.plain: Once per turn, after this model moves in your Movement phase, you can pick one unit or one point on the battlefield that it moved across. If you pick a unit, roll a D6 for each model in it, but six D6s for each VEHICLE or MONSTER model in it (to a maximum of ten D6s in total); each 4+ inflicts 1 mortal wound on that unit. If you pick a point, set up a new SPORE MINES unit of yours with 3 models on the battlefield, within 1" of that point and not within 6" of any enemy units. As updated in January 2023: setting up a Spore Mines unit this way requires spending Reinforcement Points, and this ability only works if this aircraft is still on the battlefield when its move ends.

90343dc68bf9.name: Questing Tendrils
90343dc68bf9.plain: When a unit with this adaptation fights after making a charge move this turn, its models' attacks improve their Armour Penetration by 1. This lasts until that fight is resolved.

919ccf9a7a3f.name: Armoured Exoskeleton
919ccf9a7a3f.plain: Whenever an attack is allocated to this model, reduce that attack's Damage characteristic by 1, to a minimum of 1. This doesn't stack with any other abilities that reduce an attack's Damage characteristic.

927010b2f7a0.name: Thorax Spine-maw
927010b2f7a0.plain: After this model has made its close combat attacks and before it consolidates, pick one enemy model within Engagement Range (not AIRCRAFT). That model's controlling player rolls one D6 and adds that model's Strength characteristic; if the total is equal to or less than this model's Strength characteristic, that enemy model's unit suffers D6 mortal wounds.

934c611f4219.name: Carapace Chitin Rams
934c611f4219.plain: Whenever this model makes a charge move, you can pick one enemy unit within Engagement Range and roll a D6; on a 4+, that unit takes D3 mortal wounds, or D6 mortal wounds instead if it is a VEHICLE or MONSTER unit. Also, if this model made a charge move this turn, its melee attacks add 1 to their hit rolls.

940581e1c024.name: Living Bombs (Meiotic Spores)
940581e1c024.plain: This unit automatically passes Morale tests. It is also ignored for any victory conditions: it never awards victory points, and its models don't count towards how many models are controlling an objective.

94830319f7fe.name: Spore Cysts
94830319f7fe.plain: The bearer gets the benefits of Light Cover against every ranged attack made against it.

94eb98f730a7.name: Psychic Scream
94eb98f730a7.plain: Witchfire: the nearest enemy unit within 18" of this PSYKER suffers D3 mortal wounds. Then, if it is a unit with the PSYKER keyword and your Psychic test result was higher than its Leadership characteristic, pick at random one psychic power it knows: that unit loses that power for the rest of the battle.

96942be3879f.name: Indomitable Monstrosity
96942be3879f.plain: Use in any phase, when one of your HIVE TENDRIL MONSTER units is chosen as the target of an attack. For the rest of the phase, attacks against that unit always fail to wound on an unmodified wound roll of 1-3, no matter what abilities the attacking model or its weapon has.

9712d645c80f.name: Naturalised Camouflage
9712d645c80f.plain: While a model with this adaptation has the benefits of cover from a terrain feature, add a further 1 to its armour saves against ranged attacks allocated to it.

9ab1e1b14e5a.name: Hypermorphic Biology
9ab1e1b14e5a.plain: The bearer gets 1 extra point of Toughness. Also, if the bearer has characteristics that change as it is damaged, count its remaining wounds as doubled to decide what those characteristics are.

9aecd09209da.name: Will of the Hive Mind
9aecd09209da.plain: In your Command phase, choose a <HIVE FLEET> CORE unit from your army that is within Synaptic Link range of this model. Until your next Command phase begins, hit rolls of 1 are re-rolled for attacks made by that unit's models.

waive.87: page reference to the codex, not part of the rule

9caecc208d72.name: Swarming Instincts
9caecc208d72.plain: Melee attacks by models with this adaptation add 1 to the hit roll when the target unit has fewer models than the attacker's unit. For this, each VEHICLE or MONSTER model counts as 5 models.

9d184434ba4c.name: The Void Crown
9d184434ba4c.plain:
PSYKER model only: the bearer knows 1 extra Hive Mind power, can do a psychic action and still manifest a power, and can't be denied on an unmodified 9+.
• The bearer knows one more psychic power from the Hive Mind discipline.
• The bearer can attempt a psychic action in your Psychic phase and still try to manifest one psychic power in that same phase.
• When the bearer takes a Psychic test and the unmodified result is 9+, the psychic power or psychic action can't be denied.

9d8e91a50c9c.name: The Deepest Shadow
9d8e91a50c9c.plain: Use in your opponent's Psychic phase, when a Psychic test is failed by an enemy unit. Pick one of your KRONOS PSYKER units within 18" of that enemy unit. The enemy unit takes D3 mortal wounds, and for the rest of the phase your KRONOS PSYKER unit gains this ability: Deepest Shadow (Aura): whenever a Psychic test is failed for an enemy PSYKER unit within 18" of this unit, that enemy unit takes D3 mortal wounds.

9e82d1ef6f98.name: Whipcoil Reflexes
9e82d1ef6f98.plain: Each time an enemy unit in Engagement Range of this model is chosen to Fall Back, you roll one D6; on a 2+, that unit takes D3 mortal wounds.

a00b43656890.name: Searhive
a00b43656890.plain: TOXIN SACS models only. Whenever the bearer makes a melee attack against any unit other than MONSTER and VEHICLE units, a hit automatically wounds the target.

a0b0afa537e2.name: Terrifying
a0b0afa537e2.plain: Whenever this model destroys a model in an enemy unit, subtract 1 from the Leadership characteristic of that unit's models until the end of the turn (up to a total of -4).

a1badf068cca.name: Adaptive (Kraken)
a1badf068cca.plain: When a unit with this adaptation Advances, it makes no Advance roll; instead its models add D3+3" to their Move characteristic until the end of the phase. This doesn't apply while the unit is affected by the Opportunistic Advance Stratagem or the Bounding Advance Stratagem.

a206acb10cff.name: Relentless Flurry
a206acb10cff.plain: Use in your Shooting phase or in the Fight phase, when you pick one of your LEVIATHAN units to shoot or fight. For the rest of the phase, when a model in that unit makes an attack, an unmodified hit roll of 6 scores 1 extra hit (or 2 extra hits if the unit has 11 or more models at that time). Cost: 2CP if that unit is a GENESTEALER unit, otherwise 1CP.

a2d956da80f6.name: Observer Organism
a2d956da80f6.plain: Use in your Shooting phase, when one of your EXOCRINE models is chosen to shoot. For the rest of the phase, whenever it makes an attack, the target gets no benefit of cover against it, and an unmodified hit roll of 6 scores 1 extra hit.

a386d80f86ff.name: Strategic Adaptation
a386d80f86ff.plain: After both armies deploy and before the first battle round, you can redeploy up to two of your LEVIATHAN units in your deployment zone (not this WARLORD). If the mission uses the Strategic Reserves rules, you can put any of those units into Strategic Reserves at no extra CP cost, however many units are already there. If both players have abilities that redeploy units, roll off, and the winner decides who redeploys first.

waive.40000: part of the book title "Warhammer 40,000 Core Book" in a cross-reference, which the style guide says to leave out

a6e7439b4447.name: Instinctive Rampage
a6e7439b4447.plain: Use in any phase, when an enemy unit destroys one of your <HIVE FLEET> HIVE TYRANT models. For the rest of the battle: whenever a friendly <HIVE FLEET> TYRANT GUARD unit declares a charge that targets that enemy unit, add 4 to the charge roll; and whenever a friendly <HIVE FLEET> TYRANT GUARD unit attacks that enemy unit, add 1 to the attack's hit roll and add 1 to its wound roll.

a7c84c9d593f.name: Drone Bioform
a7c84c9d593f.plain: This unit automatically passes Morale tests, can't perform actions and can't declare a charge. For scoring mission objectives or Agendas, ignore this unit and all its models. When an enemy unit is being set up on the battlefield, ignore this unit and its models for any rules that limit where that enemy unit may be placed. While an enemy unit is making a Normal Move, Advance, Fall Back or charge move, its models may pass horizontally through this unit's models, though they can't end the move on top of another model or its base. The Look Out, Sir rule ignores this unit.

a8cdc79c306c.name: Rapid Regeneration
a8cdc79c306c.plain: Use in your Command phase. Pick one HIVE TENDRIL model from your army. It regenerates, regaining up to D3 lost wounds. A model can only regenerate once per turn.

a979d2254ffd.name: Floating Death (Mucolid Spore)
a979d2254ffd.plain: Whenever a model in this unit finishes a move within 3" of any enemy units, or when an enemy unit finishes a move during which one or more of its models came within 3" of a model in this unit, that model of yours can explode. An exploding model is destroyed; pick one of those enemy units and roll a D6: on a 2-4, the picked unit takes D6 mortal wounds; on a 5+, it takes D3+3 mortal wounds.

a98d53fd8ef5.name: Death Throes
a98d53fd8ef5.plain: When this transport is destroyed, before you remove it and before any models embarked in it disembark, roll one D6. On a 6+, the nearest enemy unit within 2D6" takes D6 mortal wounds.

ad7a4259766b.name: Blinding Venom
ad7a4259766b.plain: Use at the start of the Fight phase. Pick an enemy unit that is within Engagement Range of any of your GARGOYLES units. For the rest of the phase, hit rolls for attacks made by models in that enemy unit can't be re-rolled, and subtract 1 from the hit roll of each melee attack they make.

aeef4f16de37.name: Heightened Reflexes
aeef4f16de37.plain: Units with this adaptation can shoot in a turn they Fell Back, but if they do, their ranged attacks subtract 1 from the hit roll until the end of the turn.

afe3eb61a39e.name: Prey Adaption
afe3eb61a39e.plain: When an enemy model is destroyed within 3" of this model, this model gains the following ability at the end of that phase, for the remainder of the battle: 'Prey Adaption (Aura): your <HIVE FLEET> units within 6" of this model re-roll wound rolls of 1 for their models' attacks.'

b014bd1b3f97.name: Direct Guidance
b014bd1b3f97.plain: In your Command phase, pick one of your <HIVE FLEET> CORE units within Synaptic Link range of this WARLORD to add 1 to its hit rolls. This lasts until your next Command phase starts and applies to every attack its models make.

b0ca630f0412.name: Floating Death
b0ca630f0412.plain: At the end of the Charge phase, any model in this unit that is within 3" of any enemy units explodes. For each Meiotic Spore model that explodes, roll one D6: on a 2-3, the nearest of those enemy units takes D3 mortal wounds; on a 4+, the nearest of those enemy units takes 3 mortal wounds. That Meiotic Spore model is then destroyed.

b211d9961480.name: Hyper-adaptation (Behemoth)
b211d9961480.plain: You may replace this hive fleet's Adaptive rule with one of the Hunt or Lurk Biomorphologies.

waive.61: page reference ("page 61") to where the biomorphologies are printed; not part of the rule

b2b0e7ac5da6.name: Invisible Hunter
b2b0e7ac5da6.plain: Use at the end of your turn. Pick one of your LICTOR models that wasn't set up on the battlefield this turn and take it off the battlefield. In your next Movement phase's Reinforcements step, you can set it back up anywhere on the battlefield that is wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy models. If it still isn't on the battlefield when the battle ends, it is destroyed.

b2f61faaf329.name: Synaptic Lure
b2f61faaf329.plain: Malediction: pick one enemy unit that is either within Synaptic Link range of this PSYKER or within 18" of this PSYKER. Until your next Psychic phase starts, whenever one of your KRAKEN units declares a charge with that enemy unit among its targets, you can re-roll the charge roll.

b6c752504e3a.name: Hive Tyrant
b6c752504e3a.plain: This model knows Smite and 2 psychic powers from the Hive Mind discipline.

b8c0ca7958ae.name: Synaptic Relay
b8c0ca7958ae.plain: While this model is within 12" of any friendly <HIVE FLEET> SYNAPSE unit (excluding SPOROCYST models), it gains the SYNAPSE keyword and the Synapse ability.

waive.86: page number in a cross-reference ("pg 86"), not part of the rule

bad0de01819b.name: Synaptic Goading
bad0de01819b.plain: As the first battle round starts, before any turn is taken, your ENDLESS MULTITUDE units with this adaptation can make a Normal Move of up to 6". Only units that started the battle wholly within your deployment zone can do this.

bba51f991999.name: Ambush Predators
bba51f991999.plain: Units with this adaptation can perform Heroic Interventions as though they were CHARACTER units.

bbb4e84bd7ba.name: Synaptic Legacy
bbb4e84bd7ba.plain: Use at the start of the battle round, when choosing which Synaptic Imperative ability is active for your army. If your WARLORD has the HIVE TENDRIL keyword and is on the battlefield, then this turn you may choose the Synaptic Imperative ability of a destroyed model from your army rather than one from a model on the battlefield. Unless something else allows it, you still can't choose an ability you have already chosen earlier in the battle.

bed541b41f3a.name: Infiltration Spawning
bed541b41f3a.plain: If your army is Battle-forged, each Detachment that contains any <HIVE FLEET> GENESTEALERS units can also include one <HIVE FLEET> BROODLORD unit that doesn't take up a Battlefield Role slot.

bf312c95a328.name: Barbed Ovipositor
bf312c95a328.plain: The bearer makes 1 additional attack with this weapon each time it fights, and in resolving that fight it can't make more than 1 attack with this weapon. This weapon also has the Parasitic Infection ability.

bf37565a8aec.name: Float Down
bf37565a8aec.plain: During deployment, you can put this unit high in the skies rather than on the battlefield. If you do, it arrives during the Reinforcements step of your first, second or third Movement phase (whatever the mission rules say): set it up anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy models.

bfbac61e0b35.name: Insidious Infestation
bfbac61e0b35.plain: This unit can perform the action below if it has an infestation node and no friendly <HIVE FLEET> Infestation Node marker was set up within 1" of it during deployment. Insidious Infestation (Action): in your Command phase, as many GENESTEALERS units from your army as you like can begin this action; it is finished at the end of your next Movement phase. When it finishes, the unit's <HIVE FLEET> Infestation Node marker is placed on the battlefield within 1" of it.

c19fd19f22d6.name: Lash Whip
c19fd19f22d6.plain: The bearer gets the LASH WHIP keyword, and whenever it makes a melee attack, re-roll a hit roll of 1.

c22031604835.name: Death Throes (6"/D6)
c22031604835.plain: Roll one D6 when this model is destroyed, before taking it off the battlefield: on a 6+, the nearest enemy unit within 6" takes D6 mortal wounds.

c2be81b18e62.name: Reinforced Hive Node
c2be81b18e62.plain: Use in any phase, when one of your TYRANID WARRIORS or TYRANID PRIME units is chosen as the target of an attack. For the rest of the phase, whenever an attack is allocated to one of that unit's models, subtract 1 from that attack's Damage characteristic (to a minimum of 1). Cost: 1CP if the unit has 5 or fewer models, otherwise 2CP.

c3446df73933.name: Control of the Swarm
c3446df73933.plain: Use when a LEVIATHAN WARLORD from your army is destroyed. You can immediately pick another LEVIATHAN SYNAPSE CHARACTER model from your army that has no Warlord Trait, then pick a Warlord Trait that no model in your army has and that the newly picked model can have. That model gains that Warlord Trait until the end of the battle and counts as your WARLORD for all rules purposes. Any mission objective, secondary objective, tactical objective or Agenda rules that would trigger when your original WARLORD is destroyed don't trigger until your new WARLORD is destroyed.

c352e05e9d20.name: Seed Spore Mines
c352e05e9d20.plain: This unit can perform the Seed Spore Mines action. One of your BIOVORES units can begin it at the start of your Shooting phase, and it completes at the end of that phase. Once it completes, place a new SPORE MINES unit of yours on the battlefield, wholly within 48" of this unit and more than 6" away from all enemy units; it is made up of D3 models per BIOVORES model in this unit. Since the January 2023 update, setting up that new Spore Mines unit requires spending Reinforcement Points.

c3c190b50d0a.name: The Horror
c3c190b50d0a.plain: Malediction: pick one enemy unit that is either within Synaptic Link range of this PSYKER or within 24" of this PSYKER. Until your next Psychic phase starts, subtract 2 from the Leadership characteristic of that unit's models and subtract 1 from Combat Attrition tests taken for that unit.

c3d9789e579d.name: Hyper-adaptation (Hydra)
c3d9789e579d.plain: You may replace this hive fleet's Adaptive rule with one of the Feed or Hunt Biomorphologies.

waive.61: page reference ("page 61") to where the biomorphologies are printed; not part of the rule

c3fb9a03db91.name: Shielded by the Hive Mind
c3fb9a03db91.plain: This unit's models have a 5+ invulnerable save, but the unit can never gain a Hive Fleet Adaptation.

c44e3a82c56c.name: Predator Instincts
c44e3a82c56c.plain: This model is eligible to make Heroic Interventions as if it were a CHARACTER model. For it, the range for making a Heroic Intervention is any enemy unit within 6" horizontally and 5" vertically (instead of 3" horizontally and 5" vertically), and each of its Heroic Intervention moves can be up to 6". Every other Heroic Intervention rule still applies.

c4dabab45fda.name: Infestation Node
c4dabab45fda.plain: Each <HIVE FLEET> Infestation Node marker has the abilities below, and is never treated as a model for any rule. Hive Infestation: in your Command phase, choose a <HIVE FLEET> GENESTEALERS unit from your army within 3" of this marker that hasn't been chosen for this ability yet this turn; up to D3 of its destroyed models return to it. Those models can't be placed within Engagement Range of enemy units, except enemy units already in Engagement Range of that Genestealers unit. Burn Them Out: when any phase ends, if there are enemy models within 3" of this marker and no friendly models within 3" of it, the marker is removed from the battlefield.

c4e3dec3e3fa.name: Unfeeling Resilience
c4e3dec3e3fa.plain: Models with this adaptation whose characteristics change as they take damage count their remaining wounds as double when working out those characteristics.

c51f910f0914.name: Death Frenzy
c51f910f0914.plain: Use in the Fight phase, when one of your HIVE TENDRIL CHARACTER models that hasn't yet been chosen to fight this phase is destroyed, instead of using any rules triggered by its destruction (such as the Death Throes ability). Don't remove it from play: it can fight once the attacking model's unit has finished making attacks. For those attacks, if the destroyed model's characteristics change as it suffers damage, treat it as having all its wounds remaining when working out those characteristics. After its attacks are resolved, remove it.

c59da82fd17f.name: Perfectly Adapted
c59da82fd17f.plain: Once per battle round, you can re-roll a single roll made for this WARLORD: a hit, wound, damage, Advance or charge roll, a Psychic test or a saving throw.

c5b402709c67.name: Opportunistic Advance
c5b402709c67.plain: Use in your Movement phase, when one of your KRAKEN units is chosen to move. Until the end of the turn: whenever that unit Advances, don't make an Advance roll; instead, add 8" to its models' Move characteristic until the end of the phase (a unit can't benefit from this Stratagem and from the Bounding Advance Stratagem in the same phase). Also, its models don't suffer the hit roll penalty for firing Assault weapons in a turn in which their unit Advanced.

c6161cd31ad9.name: Infinite Biomorphologies
c6161cd31ad9.plain:
If your hive fleet has no Hive Fleet Adaptation, you must create one: take the Splinter Fleet adaptation, or pick two biomorphologies from the lists.
When picking biomorphologies:
• The two must come from different lists.
• You must make one of them the Adaptive element of your adaptation; that is the part the Hyper-adaptations rule lets you swap out when the battle starts.
• If you use the Hyper-adaptations rule at the start of the battle to change that Adaptive element, the replacement must be a biomorphology from the third list, the one you didn't use when creating the adaptation.

waive.51: page reference ("pg 51") to where the Hyper-adaptations rule is printed; not part of the rule

c7074e894475.name: Toxin Sacs
c7074e894475.plain: The bearer gets the TOXIN SACS keyword. Whenever it makes a melee attack, an unmodified hit roll of 6 wounds the target automatically.

c78fb34782e8.name: Hive Fleet Adaptations
c78fb34782e8.plain:
If your army is all from one hive fleet, your HIVE TENDRIL units with this ability, and every model in them, gain that hive fleet's Hive Fleet Adaptation.
HIVE TENDRIL LIVING ARTILLERY and UNALIGNED units are ignored when checking whether your army is from one hive fleet. If your hive fleet has no Hive Fleet Adaptation of its own, you must create a new one for it instead. Either way, note every Detachment's Hive Fleet Adaptation on your army roster.

waive.60: page reference ("pages 60-61") to where the rules for creating an adaptation are printed; not part of the rule
waive.61: page reference ("pages 60-61") to where the rules for creating an adaptation are printed; not part of the rule

c9c3bf082ed0.name: Neuroparasite
c9c3bf082ed0.plain: This power's range is Synaptic Link range or 18".

cb7846b3316b.name: Synaptic Tendrils
cb7846b3316b.plain: In your Command phase, this WARLORD can use one of the abilities listed here an extra time that phase, if it has that ability. Listed abilities: Alpha Warrior, Bio-impulses, Brood Progenitor, Vicious Insight, Warp Siphon or Will of the Hive Mind.

ccadc6f45f40.name: Vicious Insight
ccadc6f45f40.plain: In your Command phase, pick one of your <HIVE FLEET> CORE units within Synaptic Link range of this model that hasn't yet been picked for this ability this turn. Until your next Command phase starts, whenever a model in that unit makes a melee attack and the wound roll is an unmodified 6, that attack's Armour Penetration is improved by 1.

waive.87: page reference to the codex, not part of the rule

d03226103574.name: Rampaging Beast
d03226103574.plain: Once per turn, when this WARLORD is picked to fight, it can use this trait: this WARLORD's Attacks characteristic goes up by D3 for the rest of the phase.

d0cd283d8ad7.name: Acid Maw
d0cd283d8ad7.plain: The bearer gets the ACID MAW keyword.

d1e5da0629bf.name: Bio-barrage
d1e5da0629bf.plain: Ranged weapons carried by models with this adaptation get 4" added to their Range characteristic.

d21b16ba2464.name: Hyper-aggression
d21b16ba2464.plain: A unit with this adaptation adds 1 to its models' Strength while fighting in a turn it made a charge move, was charged or made a Heroic Intervention. The bonus lasts until that fight is resolved.

d3f4ab5c5666.name: Gestation Sac
d3f4ab5c5666.plain: Once per battle, the bearer can do this action. Bursting the Sac (Action): this model can begin it at the start of your Shooting phase, and it completes when that phase ends. On completion, place a new <HIVE FLEET> RIPPER SWARMS unit of D3+1 models on the battlefield within 3" of this model, outside Engagement Range of all enemy units. If the game uses a points limit, that RIPPER SWARMS unit costs no Reinforcement points.

d3f6b68a752f.name: Choking Spores (Aura)
d3f6b68a752f.plain: Aura: while an enemy unit is within 3" of this model, subtract 1 from the hit roll of each attack made by models in that unit.

d484887fdbd2.name: Warp Field (Neurothrope)
d484887fdbd2.plain: This model has a 3+ invulnerable save.

d5ba3c500e56.name: Paroxysm
d5ba3c500e56.plain: Malediction: pick one enemy unit that is either within Synaptic Link range of this PSYKER or within 18" of this PSYKER. Until your next Psychic phase starts, that unit can't fire Overwatch or Set to Defend, and its models subtract 1 from the wound roll of each melee attack they make.

d8849ecd8f02.name: Toxic Miasma
d8849ecd8f02.plain: At the start of the Fight phase you may choose an enemy unit within 3" of this unit and roll one D6. On a 3+, it takes 1 mortal wound and isn't allowed to fight this phase until every eligible unit of yours has fought.

d96dc7bdd693.name: Warrior Spawning
d96dc7bdd693.plain: If your army is Battle-forged, each Detachment that contains any <HIVE FLEET> TYRANID WARRIORS units can also include one <HIVE FLEET> TYRANID PRIME model that doesn't take up a Battlefield Role slot.

d976e3ff50a6.name: Smite
d976e3ff50a6.plain: The nearest visible enemy unit within 18" of the psyker takes D3 mortal wounds. If the Psychic test came to more than 10, it takes D6 mortal wounds instead.

da16d35ec158.name: Unparalleled Ferocity
da16d35ec158.plain: Use in the Fight phase, when one of your BEHEMOTH INFANTRY units (excluding CHARACTER units) that hasn't fought yet this phase is chosen as the target of a melee attack. Until the unit making that attack finishes its attacks, whenever a model in that BEHEMOTH unit is destroyed, don't use any rules triggered by its destruction and don't remove it from play; once that attacking unit is done, the destroyed model can attack as if its unit had been chosen to fight. After those attacks are resolved, remove the destroyed model. Cost: 1CP if that BEHEMOTH INFANTRY unit has the ENDLESS MULTITUDE keyword, otherwise 2CP.

dadd7f4a37b5.name: Alien Cunning
dadd7f4a37b5.plain: This WARLORD has Objective Secured, counts as 5 models when controlling objective markers, and can start an action in a turn it Advanced or Fell Back.

db09bc97e2d1.name: Hive Commander
db09bc97e2d1.plain: In your Command phase, pick one of your <HIVE FLEET> CORE units within Synaptic Link range of this model. Until your next Command phase starts, that unit has the Objective Secured ability. If it already had that ability, each of its models counts as one extra model when working out control of an objective marker.

waive.40000: part of the book title "Warhammer 40,000 Core Book"

dbf8ed42363d.name: Shardgullet
dbf8ed42363d.plain: Only for a model equipped with a heavy venom cannon. This Relic takes the place of its heavy venom cannon.

dc982e06d3bf.name: Pheromone Trail
dc982e06d3bf.plain: Use in your Charge phase. Pick an enemy unit within 6" of one of your <HIVE FLEET> LICTOR models. For the rest of the phase, add 2 to the charge roll whenever a friendly <HIVE FLEET> unit declares a charge against that enemy unit.

dcb1a2880486.name: Living Bombs
dcb1a2880486.plain: Meiotic Spores automatically pass Morale tests. They are also ignored for any victory conditions: they never award victory points, and they don't count towards how many models are controlling an objective.

dd27bce956b6.name: Warp Blast
dd27bce956b6.plain: When this unit tries to manifest Smite or any Witchfire psychic power, its Psychic test gets 1 added for each model in the unit. When this unit manifests Smite, the mortal wounds suffered by the enemy unit increase by 1 per model in the unit, to a maximum of +3 mortal wounds.

ddc15fda85d1.name: Extended Carapace
ddc15fda85d1.plain: The bearer's Move characteristic is 7" and its Save characteristic is 4+.

ddc5b0865b22.name: Adrenalised Onslaught
ddc5b0865b22.plain: Models with this adaptation can make consolidation moves of up to 3" further than normal (to a maximum of 9").

dfc0adf115ac.name: Ablative Brood
dfc0adf115ac.plain: In a Battle-forged army, each <HIVE FLEET> HIVE TYRANT model in a Detachment lets you add one <HIVE FLEET> TYRANT GUARD unit to that Detachment, and that unit doesn't use up a Battlefield Role slot.

e13e13dca761.name: Hive Predator
e13e13dca761.plain: Use before the battle, while mustering your army, if your WARLORD has the HIVE TENDRIL keyword. Pick one of your HIVE TENDRIL CHARACTER models and determine one Warlord Trait for it (one it is allowed to have); that model counts as your Warlord only for that Warlord Trait. Every Warlord Trait in your army must be unique (if rolling randomly, re-roll duplicates), and this Stratagem can't give a model two Warlord Traits. You can use this Stratagem only once, or twice in a Strike Force battle, or three times in an Onslaught battle.

e1591b30153f.name: Synaptic Barrier
e1591b30153f.plain: Blessing: pick one of your CRUSHER STAMPEDE models within 18" of this PSYKER. That model has a 4+ invulnerable save until your next Psychic phase starts.

e183b8c13da0.name: Death Throes (3"/1)
e183b8c13da0.plain: Roll one D6 when this model is destroyed, before taking it off the battlefield: on a 6+, the nearest enemy unit within 3" takes 1 mortal wound.

e2589f38dd10.name: Bounding Leap
e2589f38dd10.plain: Whenever a model in this unit piles in, it can move up to 3" further, to a maximum of 9".

e4745a39166d.name: Blistering Assault
e4745a39166d.plain: Whenever this model fights, if it made a charge move or a Heroic Intervention this turn, add 1 to its Attacks characteristic until that fight is resolved.

e6b30b29e8f8.name: Distensible Jaws
e6b30b29e8f8.plain: Each time this model is chosen to Fight, pick one enemy unit (excluding VEHICLE units) within Engagement Range of it and roll one D6. On a 2-5, that unit takes D3 mortal wounds; on a 6, it takes 3 mortal wounds. If those mortal wounds destroy any models, that enemy unit counts as below Half-strength for Combat Attrition tests until the end of the turn.

ea0a3e905daf.name: Questing Tendrils
ea0a3e905daf.plain: Use in your second Movement phase, when you set up one of your LEVIATHAN units arriving from Strategic Reserves. You can set it up as if it were battle round 3.

ea46fcc86fbe.name: Seed Spores
ea46fcc86fbe.plain: This model can perform the Seed Spores action. One of your SPOROCYST models can begin it at the start of your Movement phase, and it completes at the end of that phase. Once it completes, place on the battlefield either a new SPORE MINES unit of yours with 6 models or a new MUCOLID SPORES unit of yours with 1 model; it must be wholly within 18" of this model and more than 6" away from all enemy units. Since the January 2023 update, setting up that new Spore Mines or Mucolid Spores unit requires spending Reinforcement Points.

ead0e98daf34.name: Wall of Flesh
ead0e98daf34.plain: While one of your <HIVE FLEET> TERMAGANTS units with 15 or more models is within 1" of this model and is closer to any enemy models than this model is, the Look Out, Sir rule is available to this model even if this unit has fewer than 3 models. TERVIGONS within range of the Wall of Flesh ability of one of your <HIVE FLEET> TERMAGANT units benefit from Look Out, Sir despite being CHARACTERS whose Wounds characteristic is more than 9. Wall of Flesh still only works with a unit of at least 15 Termagants, even though other Bodyguard abilities work with fewer than 3 models.

eb0e8c8ff451.name: Symbiostorm
eb0e8c8ff451.plain: Blessing: pick one of your KRONOS units within Synaptic Link range of this PSYKER. Until your next Psychic phase starts, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of each ranged attack made by a model in that unit.

ec0f14f7c63d.name: Hover
ec0f14f7c63d.plain: During your Command phase, this model may start hovering. If it does, its Move characteristic is 15" until the start of your next Command phase, and for that time it no longer has its Airborne Predator, Hard to Hit or Manoeuvrable abilities.

ec42a708a0a4.name: Synapse (Aura)
ec42a708a0a4.plain: Aura: your <HIVE FLEET> units automatically pass Morale tests while they are within 6" of this unit.

ee7f9d3beda0.name: Lurking Maws
ee7f9d3beda0.plain: Malediction: pick one enemy unit that is either within Synaptic Link range of this PSYKER or within 18" of this PSYKER. Until your next Psychic phase starts, whenever one of your JORMUNGANDR models makes a melee attack against that unit, that attack's Armour Penetration is improved by 1.

f021e1b7f76d.name: Bombardment Organism
f021e1b7f76d.plain: During deployment, when you set up this model, you can place it anywhere on the battlefield more than 12" away from both the enemy deployment zone and any enemy models.

f17273571a48.name: Shard Lure
f17273571a48.plain: Use in your Shooting phase, when a model in one of your <HIVE FLEET> SYNAPSE units hits an enemy unit with a ranged attack. Until the end of the turn, whenever a friendly <HIVE FLEET> unit declares a charge and that enemy unit is one of its targets, roll one extra D6 when making the charge roll and discard one of the dice.

f19bfadbc00b.name: Frenzied Metabolism
f19bfadbc00b.plain: You can use this ability the first time this model is chosen to shoot in each of your Shooting phases. If you do, this model takes D3 mortal wounds, and until the end of the phase, add 1 to the wound roll of each ranged attack it makes.

f266a86d2ded.name: It Itches
f266a86d2ded.plain: A unit loses the Objective Secured ability for as long as it is infected with parasites.

f34a163b3ddd.name: Prehensile Pincer Tail
f34a163b3ddd.plain: When resolving the bearer's attacks each time it is chosen to fight, one hit roll or one wound roll may be re-rolled.

f55660015bc0.name: Synaptic Ganglia
f55660015bc0.plain: Units with this adaptation can re-roll their Deny the Witch tests, and psychic powers they manifest get 3" more range. If a power gives more than one range, only the first range it lists gets the extra 3".

f578414aca15.name: Breaking Through
f578414aca15.plain: Use in your Charge phase, when one of your CRUSHER STAMPEDE MONSTER models finishes a charge move. Pick an enemy model within Engagement Range of it, then roll as many D6 as that MONSTER model has Wounds remaining. If the MONSTER model's Strength characteristic is higher than the enemy model's Toughness characteristic, each 3+ inflicts 1 mortal wound on the enemy model's unit; if the two are equal, each 4+ does so; if its Strength is lower, each 5+ does so. In every case, no more than 6 mortal wounds can be inflicted this way.

f5fec612d329.name: Monstrous Musculature
f5fec612d329.plain: The bearer's melee weapons each get 1 added to their Damage characteristic.

f7174958f9b1.name: Tusks
f7174958f9b1.plain: The bearer has the HORNED CHITIN keyword.

f729cb950f47.name: Enfolding Strike
f729cb950f47.plain: Use in your Movement phase, when one of your PARASITE OF MORTREX models finishes a Normal Move or an Advance. Pick an enemy unit that it moved across this phase and roll a D6: on a 2-5, that unit takes D3 mortal wounds and becomes infected with parasites (as described in the Parasitic Infection ability on the model's datasheet); on a 6, it takes 3 mortal wounds and becomes infected with parasites.

f7ddd47fc354.name: Pathogenic Slime
f7ddd47fc354.plain: Use in your Shooting phase, when one of your HIVE TENDRIL units is chosen to shoot. For the rest of the phase, any attack by a model in that unit that has an unmodified hit roll of 6 automatically wounds the target. Cost: 1CP if the unit has the TOXIN SACS keyword, otherwise 2CP.

f93d1bbece1c.name: Toxinspike
f93d1bbece1c.plain: Each time the bearer fights, it makes 1 extra attack with this weapon, and it can't make more than 1 attack with this weapon in that fight.

f959430341de.name: Wreathed in the Shadow
f959430341de.plain: Enemy units targeted by a charge from a unit with this adaptation can't fire Overwatch or Set to Defend in response to that charge.

f96a339a5451.name: Raging Influence (Aura)
f96a339a5451.plain: Aura: your CRUSHER STAMPEDE MONSTER units within 6" of this WARLORD score 1 extra hit on each unmodified melee hit roll of 6.

fa0d6381d0cb.name: Unstoppable Swarm
fa0d6381d0cb.plain: Units with this adaptation can ignore any or all modifiers that apply to their Move characteristic, Advance rolls or charge rolls.

faad8df61f28.name: Hover
faad8df61f28.plain: During your Command phase, this model may start hovering. If it does, its Move characteristic is 20" until your next Command phase, and for that time it no longer has its Airborne, Hard to Hit or Supersonic abilities.

fb9ac8821113.name: Overrun
fb9ac8821113.plain: Use at the end of the Fight phase. Pick one of your HIVE TENDRIL CORE units that made a charge move this turn. Its models can make a Normal Move, provided no enemy models are within Engagement Range of the unit.

fd21d72511a6.name: Hierodule Scything Talons
fd21d72511a6.plain: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made with this weapon.

fdbffa3dc636.name: Wrecker Claws
fdbffa3dc636.plain: If the bearer has two wrecker claws, you can re-roll the hit roll for attacks made with this weapon. Attacks made with this weapon that are allocated to a VEHICLE or MONSTER model have a Damage characteristic of 5.

fde68ab27c12.name: Spawn Termagants
fde68ab27c12.plain: In your Command phase, you can choose one of these. (1) Pick one of your <HIVE FLEET> TERMAGANTS units within 6" of this model and return up to 2D6 of its destroyed models to it, placing them back on the battlefield with their full wounds, wholly within 6" of this model and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, unless those enemy units are already within Engagement Range of that TERMAGANTS unit. (2) Once per battle, spawn a new unit: set up a new <HIVE FLEET> TERMAGANTS unit of 10 models, each equipped with fleshborers, on the battlefield wholly within 6" of this model and not within Engagement Range of any enemy units. In a game using a points limit, that unit costs no Reinforcement points.

fffbceaf5d41.name: Resonance Barb
fffbceaf5d41.plain: Only a PSYKER model can have this. Add 1 to the bearer's Psychic tests; it also knows one more psychic power from the Hive Mind discipline.
